title: 第9章 三日已到兵解第10章 好戏登场
slug: 方士开局我给秦始皇画大饼
content_zh:
时光荏苒！
晨光刺破云层，将咸阳宫阙的轮廓染上金边，薄雾漫覆秦川，如烟如黛，恍若水墨天成。
很快，时间就来到邹云推演的兵解之日。
此刻，原本宽阔的丹墀，已然变了模样。
为容纳蜂拥而至的看客，高台两侧又临时搭建许多观礼楼台。
公子扶苏一袭华服，早早便立于视野最佳之处，在他身旁，则汇聚着诸多闻风而来的王公大臣，勋贵宗室。
他们或交头接耳，或翘首以盼，目光中闪烁着难以按捺的兴奋！
这年头，大人们的娱乐项目也很匮乏。
因此，一听说今日将有方士在此地进行什么兵解仪式，便纷纷呼朋引伴，如同赶赴一场盛大庆典。
“话说，究竟什么是兵解来着？”
一个纯粹凑热闹的年轻勋贵，忍不住向四周之人开口询问。
紧挨着他的一位须发花白的老者，闻言慢悠悠地捻着颌下几缕胡须，嗤笑道。
“年轻人，你就权当他是要在此地，演一出当众自戕的好戏罢了。”
“啊...这......”
年轻勋贵闻言，神色愕然，欲言又止。
老者戏谑的回答，乍一听似乎荒谬讽刺。可细细琢磨，却又觉得直指本质，竟无可辩驳。
所谓兵解，可不正是在这煌煌天日下，上演一次自我了断的戏码吗。
“不错，长者言之有理。”
“哈哈，是极，是极。”
“什么兵解，我看不过只是那群骗子的新把戏罢了。”

周围的看客们听闻此言，也纷纷点头附和。
见众人纷纷对着‘兵解’口诛笔伐，反而是那个凑热闹的年轻勋贵，忍不住开口反驳。
“难道就没有可能，那个方士真有几分异术吗？”
此话一出，众人皆是愣了一瞬，随后齐刷刷看向那年轻勋贵，眼里流露出止不住的怪异。
‘这人怕不是傻子吧。’
‘这是谁家的公子，真是家门不幸啊。’
虽然众人未曾言语，但年轻勋贵还是从他们的眼神中，看出类似这样的意义。
年轻勋贵，或者说王翦之孙王离，看着突然尴尬起来的气氛，简直就想给自己一巴掌。
‘噫！王离啊王离，怎么就管不住你这张破嘴呢。’
不过让他承认自己刚才所言是谬语，这年轻人又拉不下脸，气氛便愈发凝滞了。
就在王离嘴唇动了动，准备说些什么打破僵局时。
突然——
“快看，来了！他们来了！！”
骤然间，一阵阵惊呼，席卷整个楼台。
一时间，所有的目光被拉扯向同一个方向，再没人注意到王离脸上的尴尬。
“咚！”
“咚！”
“咚！”
三通浑厚鼓声，如同惊雷滚过，重重敲击在每个人心头。
只见邹云面色沉静如水，无悲无喜，率先一步踏入丹墀。

他身披宽大的黑色祭服，一袭长袖在晨风中摇曳，衬得他本就清癯的身影愈发飘渺出尘。
仿佛随时会融入那尚未散尽的薄雾之中。
俄顷，一列列庞大森严的方士阵仗，亦从晨雾中缓缓显现，踏雾而来。
“这......”
content_en:
Time flies!
The morning light pierced the clouds and dyed the outline of Xianyang Palace with gold. The mist covered Qinchuan, like smoke and black, as if it were made from nature.
Soon, time came to the day of military dissolution that Zou Yun had deduced.
At this moment, the originally broad Danchi had changed its appearance.
In order to accommodate the crowds of spectators, many temporary viewing balconies were built on both sides of the high platform.
Young Master Fusu was dressed in fine clothes and stood at the best spot early on. Beside him, many princes and ministers who had heard of the news gathered to pay tribute to the clan.
They were either whispering to each other or looking forward to it, their eyes flashing with uncontrollable excitement!
These days, entertainment options for adults are also scarce.
Therefore, as soon as they heard that some alchemists were going to perform a military relief ceremony here today, they all called their friends and company as if they were rushing to a grand celebration.
"By the way, what exactly is military liberation?"
A young nobleman who was just joining in the fun couldn't help but ask the people around him.
An old man with gray hair next to him slowly twirled a few strands of beard under his chin and sneered.
"Young man, just think that he is going to stage a show of committing suicide in public here."
"Ah...this..."
When the young nobleman heard this, he looked stunned and stopped talking.
The old man's joking answer seemed ridiculous and ironic at first glance. But when I think about it carefully, I feel that it goes straight to the essence and is irrefutable.
The so-called military solution is not just a drama of self-destruction under this bright sun.
"Yes, what the elder said makes sense."
"Haha, that's right, that's right."
"What a military solution, I think it's just a new trick of those liars."
The onlookers around heard this and nodded in agreement.
Seeing that everyone was criticizing the 'Bingjie', the young nobleman who was joining in the fun couldn't help but retort.
"Isn't it possible that the alchemist really has some magic?"
As soon as these words came out, everyone was stunned for a moment, and then they all looked at the young noble, with unstoppable weirdness in their eyes.
‘I’m afraid this person is not a fool. ’
‘Whose young master is this? His family is really unfortunate. ’
Although no one said anything, the young nobleman still saw something like this in their eyes.
The young nobleman, or rather Wang Jian's grandson Wang Li, looked at the suddenly awkward atmosphere and just wanted to slap himself.
'Alas! Wang Li, Wang Li, why can't you control your nonsense? ’
But when he was asked to admit that what he just said was a lie, the young man couldn't help but feel embarrassed, and the atmosphere became even more tense.
Just when Wang Li moved his lips, he was about to say something to break the deadlock.
suddenly——
"Look, they're coming! They're coming!!"
Suddenly, waves of exclamations swept through the entire building.
For a moment, all eyes were pulled in the same direction, and no one noticed the embarrassment on Wang Li's face.
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
The thick sound of the three-way drum is like thunder rolling over, hitting everyone's heart hard.
Zou Yun's face was as calm as water, without sadness or joy, and he took the lead to step into Danqi.
He was wearing a large black sacrificial robe, and his long sleeves were swaying in the morning breeze, making his already slim figure even more ethereal.
It seems that it will merge into the mist that has not yet dispersed at any time.
After a while, rows of huge and stern alchemists slowly emerged from the morning mist and came through the mist.
"this......"
